segments.title: Group dinner, all in WhatsApp
segments.say: Plan a group dinner without leaving WhatsApp.

segments.title: Not tested by us
segments.say: Not tested by us. Based on WhatsApp's blog and WABetaInfo.

segments.title: Step 1: tap the date
bullets: Add to calendar or create event
segments.say: Step one. In the newest update, a date in a chat gets a dotted underline. Tap it to add it to your calendar, or start a WhatsApp event.

segments.title: Step 2: invite anyone
segments.say: Step two. Invite friends who aren't on WhatsApp. They open a link and RSVP. No app needed.

segments.title: Step 3: your privacy
segments.say: Step three. Guests you don't know can't see your number, and guests without WhatsApp see the address only after they RSVP.

segments.title: Settings → Events
segments.say: Find it in Settings, then Events.

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.say: Send this to your group's planner, and comment if you want a real hands-on test.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
